persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a realistic 5-second widescreen video of a golden retriever catching a red frisbee in a grassy park. One continuous shot with the camera staying still, no sound.
bank.Source image: No photo; generate it from the description.
bank.Style and setting: Realistic golden retriever in a grassy park; lighting is your call.
bank.Action: The dog catches a flying red frisbee in its mouth.
bank.Camera, text and audio: Stationary camera, one continuous shot, no text or sound.

messages.text: Could you make a realistic video of a golden retriever catching a red frisbee in a grassy park? I’ve always had a soft spot for golden retrievers, so this seemed like a fun thing to ask for. What I have in mind is 5 seconds long and widescreen, with everything happening in one continuous shot. I’m probably over-explaining because I don’t often know how to describe video ideas. Please keep the camera staying still throughout, and have no sound.
